171:t_1:3.en: ～$$プトレマイオス２改$$　Briefing Room～

171:t_1:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Captain $$ブライト$$... What did Colonel $$シャア$$ mean about $$プラント$$'s movements?」

171:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$プラント$$ has leaned toward $$ネオ・ジオン$$ since the $$時獄戦役$$...」

171:t_1:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$シャア$$ saw the situation as dangerous and was investigating $$プラント$$ himself...」

171:t_1:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That tendency has grown stronger in recent weeks. He judged that full-scale armed intervention, unheard of even in the $$時獄戦役$$, might occur.」

171:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「So Colonel $$シャア$$ came to the $$ラー・カイラム$$ to discuss how to respond.」

171:t_1:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Could they have known about $$フル・フロンタル$$'s declaration in advance and be responding to it?」

171:t_1:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「When $$シャア$$ led $$ネオ・ジオン$$, he questioned $$プラント$$'s haste and kept their cooperation in check.」

171:t_1:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Now that $$フロンタル$$ leads them, $$プラント$$ is finally making its move...」

171:t_1:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But Chairman $$ギルバート$$ 《$$デュランダル$$》, their leader, fell during $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$...」

171:t_1:14.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I heard that $$プラント$$ shifted to a policy of cooperation with Earth.」

171:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$クライン派$$'s efforts played a large part in that.」

171:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Do you mean the faction led by the songstress $$ラクス・クライン$$...?」

171:t_1:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Are you saying their influence has weakened?」

171:t_1:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That's the only way to put it.」

171:t_1:20.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What's wrong, Captain $$オットー$$?」

171:t_1:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「Is it possible... the $$クライン派$$ has joined forces with $$ネオ・ジオン$$?」

171:t_1:22.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I don't think so. I can't imagine $$ラクス・クライン$$, the symbol of the $$クライン派$$, allowing that.」

171:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I agree. ...But I understand Captain $$オットー$$'s concerns, too.」

171:t_1:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「For now, all we can do is wait to hear from $$キラ$$ and the others who infiltrated ahead of us.」

171:t_1:25.en:
$$オットー$$
「Can't we contact $$シン・アスカ$$ in $$プラント$$?」

171:t_1:27.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Given all that, we'd better be prepared for something to have happened in $$プラント$$.」

171:t_1:28.en:
$$ブライト$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$, $$シン$$ and $$キラ$$ said that $$プラント$$ was being swept toward war by emotion.」

171:t_1:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Finding the root of that will be the key to understanding what's happening...」

171:t_1:33.en: ～$$プラント$$　$$アプリリウス市$$　Hidden Passage～

171:t_1:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's take a short rest, $n. We've walked nonstop since we got in. You must be tired.」

171:t_1:36.en:
$n
「No... I'm fine. I'm also worried about $$ヒイロ$$ and the others taking the other route.」

171:t_1:37.en:
$$キラ$$
「You don't have to push yourself. We're almost where we're meeting $$ラクス$$, and it's safe here.」

171:t_1:38.en:
$n
「...Then, could we talk for a little while?」

171:t_1:39.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's why you wanted to come with me, isn't it?」

171:t_1:40.en:
$n
「Yes... It felt a little hard to talk about aboard the ship...」

171:t_1:42.en:
$n
「...I... met Ensign $$リディ$$ soon after I started piloting the $$ジェニオン$$, but...」

171:t_1:43.en:
$n
「Since near the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, I haven't really understood him...」

171:t_1:45.en:
$n
「I imagine things were hard with his family and all, but I want to know why Ensign $$リディ$$ changed.」

171:t_1:46.en:
$n
「I thought you might know something, since you were with him in $$オーブ$$...」

171:t_1:47.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ is... like you... No, like all of us.」

171:t_1:49.en:
$$キラ$$
「He fought to the end to protect what he cared about and believed in.」

171:t_1:50.en:
$$キラ$$
「I think he seemed to change because what he cared about took up far more of his heart than anything else.」

171:t_1:51.en:
$n
「Are you like that, too, $$キラ$$? Do you fight for what you care about and believe in?」

171:t_1:53.en:
$n
「Do you mean... $$ラクス$$, who we're about to meet?」

171:t_1:55.en:
$n
「Oh... Um... Sorry... I'm not trying to pry... It's just... $$シン$$ said something like that before...」

171:t_1:57.en:
$$キラ$$
「But it might be a little different from what you're imagining.」

171:t_1:58.en:
$$キラ$$
「It isn't just $$ラクス$$ I care about. It's everything she believes in, wishes for, and works toward.」

171:t_1:60.en:
$$キラ$$
「Really? I think it's the same as what you feel for Miss $$スズネ$$...」

171:t_1:61.en:
$n
「You mean what I... feel for Miss $$スズネ$$...?」

171:t_1:62.en:
$$キラ$$
「...Sorry. There's someone else you care about, isn't there?」

171:t_1:64.en:
$n
「I don't really understand my feelings for $$マキ#pilot$$ myself... With the world like this, our lives don't line up anymore...」

171:t_1:65.en:
$n
「Right now... as long as she's alive and safe... that's...」

171:t_1:66.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ was the same as you. That's why he fought so desperately...」

171:t_1:67.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's do our best, $n, to protect what we care about.」

171:t_1:75.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'm surprised you chose the Council's conference room as our meeting place...」

171:t_1:76.en:
$$ラクス$$
「There was something I absolutely had to tell you here.」

171:t_1:77.en:
$$キラ$$
「You have something to tell me...?」

171:t_1:79.en:
$$キラ$$
「Someone came with me, but he's standing guard outside the conference room.」

171:t_1:80.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Is he a 《$$コーディネイター$$》?」

171:t_1:85.en:
$$キラ$$
「What's wrong, $$ラクス$$? You're not yourself...」

171:t_1:86.en:
$$ラクス$$
「I'm sorry, $$キラ$$... I wanted to contact you sooner, but I couldn't sort out my own feelings...」

171:t_1:87.en:
$$キラ$$
「It's all right, $$ラクス$$. Do it in whatever way feels right to you. I'll wait.」
